That is about 4.7 widths, and the base is beyond the frame. So the numbers ask for a tower roughly half as slender as the reference and the real landmark. The height can't grow (tip kept below y 0.20, base at 0.80), so the width has to shrink to about 0.06 (x 0.47 to 0.53), about five widths from tip to base.
